title: Comparison of a New Semi-invasive Monitoring System With Transpulmonary Thermodilution in Cardiac Surgery Patients
brief_summary: The aim of the study is to investigate the accuracy of a new semi-invasive cardiac output monitoring system in patients undergoing elective cardiac surgery. The investigators hypothesize that the semi-invasive device may be affected by mean arterial pressure and systemic vascular resistance.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Patients undergoing elective coronary artery bypass grafting Personal declaration of consent to the study

Exclusion Criteria:

Patients \<18 years of age A left ventricular ejection fraction ≤0.5 Emergency procedures Patients with haemodynamic instability requiring continuous pharmacologic support Patients with intracardiac shunts Severe aortic-, tricuspid- or mitral stenosis or insufficiency Mechanical circulatory support.
